item.title: Davis Waldorf School's Parent & Child Class — Fri Sep 18, 10:00 AM — Davis Waldorf School
item.description:
The first three years in a child’s life are an amazing time of growth that fill parents and caregivers with awe and wonder. Parent & Child classes are held in a warm and welcoming environment that is carefully arranged for creative play in our Buttercup Preschool room. This program offers the very young child freedom to explore within loving boundaries, and teaches parents/caregivers about Waldorf education’s many benefits. Classes are led by an experienced Early Childhood educator and echo the rhythms of the Waldorf preschool. Additionally, classes offer caregivers a place to connect about child development and parenting techniques. We welcome caregivers of all kinds—parents, grandparents, nannies—to join our sessions!
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Bomba Fried Rice Live at The HIVE — Fri Sep 18, 5:30 PM — The HIVE Tasting Room and Kitchen
item.description:
Live at The HIVE presents Bomba Fried Rice during an outdoor concert. Doors at 5:30pm; Music at 6:30pm. Bomba Fried Rice is a diverse ensemble from people all around the world and the community of Davis. Recognized as a prominent local and unique music ensemble, they play Latin genres ranging from Salsa, Rock, Reggae, Spoken Word, Cumbia, Mambo, and Ska, merging cultures and styles of music. In 2015, Bomba Fried Rice won a SAMMIE (Sacramento Music Award) for Best World Music Ensemble. Enjoy a seasonal menu, craft beverages and complimentary honey tasting at northern California’s largest honey and mead tasting room. Pay what you can cover charge: $0-$20/person. Family and dog friendly. All ages welcome. No outside food or drinks.
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Skate Park Grand Opening — Fri Sep 18, 5:30 PM — Community Park
item.description: READY TO ROLL: CITY OF DAVIS CELEBRATES NEW SKATEPARK The City of Davis Parks and Community Services Department is excited to announce the ribbon cutting ceremony for the renovated Community Park Skatepark on Friday, September 18, from 5:30 to 7 p.m. All are invited to attend this celebration that will feature a ribbon cutting, vendors, free merchandise and music. The skatepark represents the City’s continued investment in improving existing infrastructure while creating an exciting destination for residents and visitors for years to come. In 2024, the City determined that the 30+ year old skatepark was outdated and needed a complete overhaul. Through community outreach, the City released and reviewed proposals for a full design and build renovation of the skatepark. Designed and constructed by Grindline Skateparks, Inc., a company known for their world-class projects and reputation for combining community needs with skateboard use. item.title: Hot & Bothered (Sex, Menopause and Mocktails) — Fri Sep 18, 6:30 PM — 1550 Cannery Ave
item.description:
Join us for an intimate evening of mocktails, delicious bites, and honest conversation about one of the least talked-about parts of midlife: sex and intimacy during menopause. Whether you’re experiencing changes in desire, discomfort with sex, shifts in your relationship, or simply wondering “Is this normal?” you’re not alone. Together, we’ll explore how menopause affects our bodies, brains, and relationships, bust common myths, discuss evidence-based treatment options, and reimagine what intimacy can look like in this stage of life. You’ll leave feeling informed, empowered, and hopeful, with practical tools and resources you can actually use. More info and sign-up here: https://tocarrywonder.com/events-perimenopause-menopause/
Source: The Dirt

item.title: The Addams Family Musical — Fri Sep 18, 7:30 PM — Davis Musical Theatre Co. (DMTC)
item.description:
A comical feast that embraces the wackiness in every family, features an original story and a dilemma that’s every father’s nightmare: Wednesday Addams, the ultimate princess of darkness, has grown up and fallen in love with a sweet, smart young man from a respectable family whom her parents have never met. She confides in her father and begs him not to tell her mother. Now, Gomez Addams must do something he’s never done before– keep a secret from his beloved wife, Morticia. Everything will change for the whole family on the fateful night they host a dinner for Wednesday’s “normal” boyfriend and his parents. Recommended for ages 10 and up
Source: The Dirt

item.title: The Black Feathers Live — Fri Sep 18, 8:00 PM — The Melon Ball – Watermelon Music
item.description:
The Black Feathers, Irish and English-born singer-songwriters Ray Hughes and Sian Chandler are currently residing in Wales, UK — married in life and to the stage since 2012. Over the last few years, they have been spreading their wings across the US and western Canada. Americana, Folk, and Acoustic Indie Rock sensibilities coexist comfortably in their musical world, with Hughes’ guitar work buoying the kind of harmonies often only heard in family bands. Their music quickly draws the interest of listeners, but it is the stage chemistry that will keep them riveted. $20 General Admission Advanced Purchase $25 General Admission At The Door Show starts at 8:00pm Doors open at 7:30pm This is a BYOB Event
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Grounded Together: Building Resilience, Connection, and Community — Wed Sep 30, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Iama Embodied Community ***P.S. this is part of a 5 week series, though not required, you are highly encouraged to attend all - No meeting on Oct 7***
Join **Rev. Rola Al-Ashkar** for a five-week journey exploring how our life experiences shape the way we respond to stress, conflict, belonging, and relationships. Through storytelling, guided reflection, and gentle body-centered (somatic) practices, participants will develop tools for greater self-awareness, emotional resilience, and compassionate listening. Whether you're seeking personal growth, healthier relationships, or a deeper sense of connection within our community, this series offers a welcoming and supportive space. No prior experience is necessary. Please register using the following link: [[LINK](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdxWVImvnFcRLw5on8gH2WFGQfoMnVmNowpxZd9FHajblr2Iw/viewform?usp=send_form)]. **Wednesdays:** Sept. 16, 23, 30; Oct. 14 & 21 6:00 – 8:00 pm

item.title: Davis City Council Meetings — Thu Dec 3, 6:30 PM — City Hall Community Chambers
item.description:
The Davis City Council provides policy direction, establishes goals, and sets priorities for City government. City Council holds regular meetings beginning at 6:30 p.m. on Tuesdays. Most commonly, meetings are held on the first and third Tuesdays of the month, with additional meetings scheduled as needed. The City Council meeting schedule is subject to change.
The Davis City Council meets in the Community Chambers at City Hall, 23 Russell Boulevard. All regular meeting materials are posted at least 72 hours in advance and special meeting materials at least 24 hours in advance.
Visit the City Council site for information on agenda, special meetings, and more.
Source: Hate-Free Together
